protocol: Regenerate each exact frozen R19 world and recheck all structural hashes.
Run the byte-frozen R18 candidate to terminal before any truth witness.
Build one independent incremental Minisat22 solver over the original frame; query the entire bridge domain and replay every SAT model.

Evaluate the terminal candidate DAG over the same entire bridge domain by exact bit-parallel Boolean vectors: one Python integer bit per bridge assignment, node AND -> bitwise &, node OR -> bitwise |, negative literal -> complement within the frozen domain mask.
The bit-parallel evaluator may not alter candidate nodes, quantification, elimination order, or representation.
Compare complete allowed sets, counts, and canonical list hashes.

bitparallel_representation_contract.domain_bits: 2^|B| bits packed into Python arbitrary-precision integers
bitparallel_representation_contract.target_invariant: truth of the already-completed candidate DAG for every bridge assignment

epistemic_rule: R20B evidence is supplemental and may resolve the semantic unknown for these four worlds, but historical R19 remains six PASS + four OPEN under its original frozen workflow contract.
promotion_rule: Four supplemental MATCH outcomes permit the statement that all ten fresh R19 frozen worlds have now received exact semantic confirmation across R19+R20B evidence, while still preserving R19's original execution verdict. Any mismatch is a new semantic counterexample.
claim_ceiling: No totality, global polynomial runtime, arbitrary-CNF SAT-in-P, P=NP, or P!=NP claim follows.
